hits.title: Foundation Consumer Healthcare Undergoes Major Leadership Changes to Focus on Women's Health Market - Third News
hits.snippet: In a bold move to reinforce its position in the burgeoning women's health sector, Foundation Consumer Healthcare (FCH) has announced significant changes in its senior leadership. Rupa Bahri, formerly of Haleon, has been appointed as the new CEO of the company, a strategic transition aimed at enhancing FCH's focus on women's health products. This change comes soon after the company successfully streamlined its portfolio, which included a targeted divestiture of its over-the-counter wellness brands to Prestige Consumer Healthcare in June 2026. The new appointment marks not just a change at the top but signals FCH's commitment to evolving into a dedicated player in women’s health. Rupa Bahri expressed her excitement about this new journey, stating, "I am honored to join Foundation Consumer Healthcare at such a transformative time. The team has an iconic brand in Plan B, and we have an opportunity to create an exceptional platform. Women's health represents one of the most dynamic and crucial opportunities in health care today."
